title: Shared review identity, ACL, scope and safe-transport fixtures
classification: P0-02 partial fixture implementation; no newly claimed production vulnerability

verification.database: Disposable PostgreSQL 17.6 upgraded to current Alembic head; removed after each run
verification.settings: Synthetic; root dotenv disabled; Python non-loopback network blocked by runner; opt-in fixture permits only loopback database TCP port and corresponding DNS
verification.identities: Real User/ApiToken/PersistentLoginSession rows; production issue/hash/validation and disable revocation
verification.authority: Real UserLibraryAccess plus native EmulatorMutationData, request authentication, save storage and generation persistence
verification.filesystem: Synthetic legacy collision bytes retained; child replacement keeps prior bytes; denial leaves row/file snapshot and unrelated sentinel unchanged

red_and_rework: New guard/seed cases initially fail on missing helper; these are missing-fixture errors, not production exploit reproductions.
First seeded run correctly rejected disabled identity after ORM revocation; corrected the fixture assertion.
Windows asyncio creates a trusted internal socket pair; create its event loop before installing the database-only network boundary rather than permitting arbitrary loopback connections.
Two explicit invalid-port cases reproduced the helper accepting ports 0 and 65536; reject ports outside 1..65535. Both now pass in the combined selection.
limitations: Only selected native emulator save operations are exercised; no route promoted to fully verified parity.
Root rolled-back test session proves these single-session paths, not concurrent PostgreSQL locking or process restart.
Temporary files remain pytest-managed; no broad deletion. Owned disposable test database cleanup is verified.
Filesystem write/rename/fsync/commit fault seams, delayed/stale provider fixtures and a browser controlled by a real old service worker remain open.
P0-01/P0-02 remain partial; no release/deployment readiness claim.
